text:
Before: the meal was a salad (spinach, cucumber, tomatoes, about 60 g), a bowl of mixed vegetables (carrot, broccoli, corn, about 130 g), and two cannelloni/crepes with meat sauce (about 200 g). Water is not counted.

After: the salad plate still has the tomatoes and some carrot, so roughly half the salad was eaten. The vegetable bowl has only corn left, so the carrots and broccoli were eaten and about 40% of the vegetables remain. The main dish is almost entirely eaten, with only a smear of sauce left.

Estimated eaten:
- Main: about 190 g at about 1.6 kcal/g, so about 300 kcal. Meat-filled cannelloni with cheese and sauce is roughly 150–180 kcal per 100 g, so I'm using about 310 kcal.
- Vegetables: about 80 g at about 0.6 kcal/g, so about 50 kcal.
- Salad: about 30 g, so about 8 kcal, plus a little dressing, call it 15 kcal.

Total: about 190 + 80 + 30 = 300 g, and about 310 + 50 + 15 = 375 kcal.

{"kcal": 375, "mass_g": 300}
